query:
SELECT i.id                   AS "id!",
               i.team_slug            AS "team_slug!",
               i.role::text           AS "role!",
               i.invited_by_profile_id AS "invited_by_profile_id!",
               i.created              AS "created!",
               i.expires_at           AS "expires_at!"
        FROM vw_invitee_invitations i
        WHERE i.invitee_profile_id = $1
        ORDER BY i.created DESC
